name: Fremont Street Experience
title: Fremont Street Experience
description: Pedestrian mall and attraction in downtown Las Vegas, Nevada, occupying the westernmost five blocks of Fremont Street (Glitter Gulch). Features a 90 ft barrel vault canopy spanning 4 blocks.
intro: The Fremont Street Experience (FSE) is a pedestrian mall and attraction in downtown Las Vegas, Nevada. The FSE occupies the westernmost five blocks of Fremont Street, including the area known for years as Glitter Gulch, and portions of some other adjacent streets. The central attraction is a barrel vault canopy, 90 ft (27 m) high at the peak and four blocks, or about 1,375 ft (419 m), in length.
